accessibility.description: Dawn Access speaks menus, settings, subtitles with speaker names, dialogue history, objectives, collectibles and status pages through NVDA, JAWS, Narrator or SAPI, with braille support. Choices, timed choices, quick-time events and Don't Move are announced with the key to press and directional tones. Exploration offers a list of reachable things, room names, a sound beacon and automatic walking; aiming has a lock-on key and tones. Photos, documents and film scenes are described. Keyboard and Xbox, DualSense and DualShock 4 controller keys are included. It covers all 20 game languages on Windows and requires the PC remake.
